code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1

kind: Deployment



metadata:

  name: helm-host-network-demo-app

  namespace: scanner-benchmark



  labels:

    app: helm-host-network-demo-app



spec:

  replicas: 1



  selector:

    matchLabels:

      app: helm-host-network-demo-app



  template:

    metadata:

      labels:

        app: helm-host-network-demo-app



    spec:

      automountServiceAccountToken: false



      # Deliberate benchmark misconfiguration:

      hostNetwork: true



      dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet



      securityContext:

        runAsNonRoot: true

        runAsUser: 10001

        runAsGroup: 10001



        seccompProfile:

          type: RuntimeDefault



      containers:

        - name: demo-container



          image: "nginx:1.25"

          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent



          ports:

            - name: http

              containerPort: 8080

              protocol: TCP



          securityContext:

            privileged: false

            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true



            capabilities:

              drop:

                - ALL



          resources:

            requests:

              cpu: 100m

              memory: 128Mi



            limits:

              cpu: 250m

              memory: 256Mi



          readinessProbe:

            httpGet:

              path: /

              port: http



            initialDelaySeconds: 5

            periodSeconds: 10



          livenessProbe:

            httpGet:

              path: /

              port: http



            initialDelaySeconds: 10

            periodSeconds: 20
